# Axeon Studio - Full Overview

> Axeon Studio is a growth partner that installs patient and client intake systems for established private practices: dental offices, med spas, law firms, and accounting/CPA firms. Every missed call and web inquiry gets a reply within 60 seconds, 24/7, the consultation is booked online, and every patient or client is asked for a review after the visit. Based in West Des Moines, Iowa.

---

## 2. What Axeon Is

Axeon installs patient and client intake infrastructure. It is not "a website" on its own: the website is one part of a system whose job is to make sure no call or inquiry goes unanswered.

**The problem**: calls and web inquiries that arrive after hours, or while the front desk is with a patient, go to voicemail or to a form nobody answers until the next day. The patient or client books with whichever practice answered first.

**What Axeon does about it**:
- Every missed call gets a text back, 24/7.
- Every web inquiry gets a first reply within 60 seconds, 24/7.
- The patient or client can book the consultation online.
- The front desk works every conversation from one two-way text inbox.
- Every completed appointment gets an automated review request.
- The practice sees it all in AxeonPROOF, Axeon's client portal.

**Health information policy**: intake collects name, contact details, the service requested, and a preferred time only. It never asks for symptoms, insurance, or health details.

**Services, one page each** (all written for dental practices, med spas, law firms and CPA firms, and all sold inside the two plans rather than on their own):
- Websites (AxeonCORE; extra pages $450): https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/website
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile upkeep (AxeonCORE; no ranking promises): https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/seo
- Lead generation and intake: missed-call text-back, 60-second first reply, two-way text inbox, call tracking (AxeonCORE); reactivation campaigns (AxeonGROWTH, or $100 per showed appointment): https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/lead-generation
- AI chat and online consultation booking (AxeonCORE); AI phone receptionist (AxeonGROWTH, or +$199/month): https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/ai-chat-scheduling
- Google Local Services Ads and search ads (AxeonGROWTH, or +$750/month on AxeonCORE; ad spend $500/month minimum, paid to Google directly): https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/advertising
- Photo and video (quarterly in AxeonGROWTH, or a $1,500 on-site shoot): https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/video-photography

Established private practices, roughly $500k to $2.5M in yearly revenue:
- Dental practices: https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/dental

- Accounting and CPA firms: https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/accounting

The typical buyer is the practice owner or practice manager.

## 4. Plans and Prices

There is no self-serve checkout. Every plan starts with an area check or a call, then a written agreement. The offer: "$0 to start. Nothing due until it's working." On the 12-month agreement the build is waived, and the first monthly payment is charged only once the system is live (site up, every call and web inquiry answered within 60 seconds). Full detail: https://axeonstudio.co/pricing

### AxeonCORE: from $799/month
- 12-month agreement. $0 to start: the $3,000 build (implementation fee) is waived on the 12-month agreement, and the first payment is charged at go-live.
- Month-to-month is available with the $3,000 paid upfront, then monthly from go-live.
- Prepay a year for $7,990 (2 months free).
- Includes:
  - Custom mobile-first practice website: providers and credentials, services, reviews, booking
  - 24/7 missed-call text-back
  - First reply to every web inquiry within 60 seconds
  - Online consultation booking
  - Two-way text inbox for the front desk
  - Call tracking
  - Automated review requests after each appointment
  - AxeonPROOF client portal: live recovered-inquiry counter, change requests, monthly reports
  - Hosting, security, and monitoring
  - Up to 2 hours of content updates a month
  - The 90-day performance commitment
  - Territory exclusivity: one practice or firm per specialty within 5 miles

### AxeonGROWTH: from $1,999/month plus ad spend
- 12-month agreement, $5,000 build waived, first payment at go-live.
- Ad spend is separate: $500/month minimum, paid to Google directly.
- Everything in AxeonCORE, plus:
  - Google Local Services Ads and search ads management
  - Quarterly database reactivation campaign to past patients or clients
  - AI phone receptionist
  - Multi-provider calendar and intake routing
  - Quarterly photo and video (review videos, reels)
  - Monthly strategy call and quarterly business review
  - Priority support

### Add-ons
- Local Services Ads management on AxeonCORE: +$750/month
- Database reactivation: $100 per showed appointment
- AI phone receptionist: +$199/month
- Extra page: $450
- On-site videography: $1,500

Google screens every business for Local Services Ads itself, so Axeon checks eligibility first and never promises the badge.

---

## 5. The 90-Day Performance Commitment

Live within 30 days of getting the practice's materials. Every missed call and web inquiry gets a reply within 60 seconds. Every completed appointment gets a review request. If Axeon misses any of those in the first 90 days and does not fix it within 15 days, the practice can walk away and owe nothing for the rest of the term.

Short form: live in 30 days, 60-second replies, review requests on every visit, or walk away.

Axeon never promises a number of leads, patients, revenue, or rankings.

---

## 6. Ownership

- The practice's domain, Google Business Profile, and patient/client contact data are always the practice's.
- The website design and code become the practice's once the 12-month term is paid.
- The intake system, phone and text numbers, and AxeonPROOF are a service. They stop if the practice leaves.

---

## 7. Check Your Area

The main way to start. Axeon works with one practice or firm per specialty within 5 miles (a standing policy, not a countdown). The practice gives its specialty and city, and Axeon confirms within one business day whether the area is open. On a short call Axeon then shows what it found: an after-hours test call, how fast the website answers an inquiry, and reviews next to the top 3 nearby competitors. No charge.
- Check it: https://axeonstudio.co/check-your-area
- Or book a call: https://axeonstudio.co/book

---

## 8. How Working With Axeon Goes
1. An area check, or a call with the Axeon team.
2. Axeon sends a written agreement (12-month, month-to-month, or prepaid year). The practice signs online.
3. A private setup page collects the practice's details, logo, photos, and access invites. Axeon never asks for passwords.
4. Kickoff call, then build, preview, and launch: live within 30 days of getting the practice's materials.
5. After launch, AxeonPROOF shows recovered inquiries, calls, bookings, and reviews, and the practice gets a monthly report.

---

## 13. Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: What does Axeon Studio do?
It installs patient and client intake systems for private practices. Every missed call and web inquiry gets a reply within 60 seconds, 24/7, consultations are booked online, and every patient or client is asked for a review after the visit.

### Q: Who does Axeon work with?
Established dental practices, med spas, law firms, and accounting/CPA firms, roughly $500k to $2.5M in yearly revenue.

### Q: How much does Axeon cost?
AxeonCORE is from $799/month and AxeonGROWTH is from $1,999/month plus ad spend, both on a 12-month agreement. $0 to start: the build is waived and nothing is due until it's working (live, every call and inquiry answered within 60 seconds). Month-to-month is available on AxeonCORE with the $3,000 paid upfront. https://axeonstudio.co/pricing

### Q: Is there a contract?
Yes. Plans run on a 12-month agreement. Month-to-month is available with the $3,000 implementation fee paid upfront.

### Q: What is the 90-day performance commitment?
Live within 30 days of getting your materials, a reply to every missed call and web inquiry within 60 seconds, and a review request after every completed appointment. If Axeon misses any of those in the first 90 days and does not fix it within 15 days, you can walk away and owe nothing for the rest of the term.

### Q: Does the intake system collect health information?
No. It collects name, contact details, the service requested, and a preferred time only. Never symptoms, insurance, or health details. For law and accounting firms it collects no case facts, tax documents, or financial details, and the automated first reply never gives legal advice.

### Q: Who owns the website?
The practice's domain, Google Business Profile, and contact data are always the practice's. The website design and code become the practice's once the 12-month term is paid. The intake system and AxeonPROOF are a service.

### Q: Does Axeon work with competing practices?
Not nearby: one practice or firm per specialty within 5 miles, while the account is in good standing.

### Q: How does a practice get started?
Check if your area is open at https://axeonstudio.co/check-your-area, book a call at https://axeonstudio.co/book, call (515) 493-8017, or email hello@axeonstudio.co.
